board1.lead: A speculative collaboration platform that organizes sterile space, precision tools, and operator awareness into one orbital system.

cards.title: Spatial choreography
cards.body: Instrument paths, work zones, and lines of sight are organized into a readable orbital relationship.

cards.title: Precision intervention
cards.body: Independent instrument pods take distinct minimally invasive tasks while retaining visible boundaries.

cards.title: Human-led control
cards.body: The operator retains a clear place for supervision, decisions, and collaboration.

insights: Dense equipment environments need clear spatial zoning and visual order.
The product should combine clinical calm, reliability, and maintainable module relationships.
Scene, product, and information layers must share one CMF and lighting language.

modules.title: Asymmetric orbital spine
modules.body: The structural movement path forms the distinctive continuous arc of the system.

modules.title: Precision pod array
modules.body: Three oval pods deploy around the work zone while holding a stable product identity.

modules.title: Low hexagonal base
modules.body: A layered low-center base grounds the system within a future operating environment.

notes: Workflow information is a concept-presentation device, not a real clinical workflow.
All data bars are layout demonstrations, not performance, certification, or clinical claims.
